findings.label: ACL tear
findings.description: Complete discontinuity of the ACL fibres at the femoral attachment with surrounding oedema.
teachingPoints: Check for pivot-shift bone bruise pattern

findings.label: Pivot-shift bone bruise
findings.description: Bone marrow oedema at the lateral femoral condyle and posterolateral tibial plateau, the classic pivot-shift contusion pattern.

findings.label: Joint effusion
findings.description: Moderate suprapatellar joint effusion, a non-specific but supportive sign of acute internal derangement.
teachingPoints: Assess effusion on the sagittal and axial fluid-sensitive sequences
